commit.message:
[security] Address remaining reported security issues

Related issue:
https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2091796

Ensure extracted checksum in diff updater is at least 10-character
long, fail if not so.

Ensure asset viewer in subscription mode is not embedded. Disable
ability to subscribe if so.

Code review changes in previous commit:
https://github.com/gorhill/uBlock/commit/736ef4d100
